title: Four Ways Data Analytics Impact Your Fitness Business

facts.fact: Over 2.5 quintillion bytes of data are generated every day, according to the article.
facts.quote: Would you believe over 2.5 quintillion bytes of [data](http://www.club-os.com/) are generated every single day?

facts.fact: A McKinsey Global Research Institute survey concluded organizations that use data to analyze customer behavior and implement insights into sales strategies outperform peers by 85% in sales growth.
facts.quote: organizations that use data to analyze customer behavior and then implement those insights into their sales strategies outperform their peers by 85% in sales growth

facts.fact: The same McKinsey-based claim states such organizations outperform peers by more than 25% in gross margin.
facts.quote: outperform their peers by 85% in sales growth and more than 25% in gross margin

facts.fact: Companies that are very data-driven are three times more likely to report a significant improvement in decision-making within their organization, per the article.
facts.quote: companies that are very data-driven are three times more likely to report experiencing a significant improvement in decision-making

facts.fact: In a PricewaterhouseCoopers survey of over 2,100 executives, 61% acknowledged their companies could rely on data analysis more and intuition less.
facts.quote: A PricewaterhouseCoopers survey of over 2,100 executives found the following: “Two-thirds (61%) acknowledge their companies could rely on data analysis more and intuition less.

facts.fact: Per the article, 83% of consumers are willing to share their data to create a more personalized experience.
facts.quote: “83% of consumers are willing to share their data to create a more personalized experience.”
